Do you enjoy turning marketing plans into campaigns that are visible, engaging and deliver measurable results? Are you fluent in English as well as Dutch or German?

Are you looking for a broad marketing role where content, campaigns, events, social media and commercial collaboration all come together?

Then this could be your next opportunity.

For our European headquarters in Maastricht, myenergi is looking for a Marketing & Communications Specialist Europe. In this varied role, you will coordinate and deliver our European marketing activities, with a strong focus on the Benelux and DACH regions.

You will have plenty of opportunity to take ownership: from managing the marketing calendar and creating content to organising events, supporting commercial partners and analysing campaign performance.

About myenergi

myenergi is a fast-growing international business focused on smart energy solutions. From our European headquarters in Maastricht, we work closely with colleagues and partners across a wide range of European markets.

As our organisation continues to grow, our roles and responsibilities evolve with it. We are therefore looking for someone who is excited not only about stepping into this position, but also about helping shape its future.

Taken
What will you do?

As Marketing & Communications Specialist Europe, you turn marketing plans into practical, visible and measurable results.

Your responsibilities include:

- Plan and coordinate the European marketing and campaign calendar, including product launches, promotions and seasonal activities.

- Manage myenergi’s digital channels and content, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube, and create engaging copy, graphics, photography and video.

- Create and manage customer and partner communications, including newsletters, website and landing-page content, product information and other digital communications.

- Develop and maintain marketing and sales materials, such as brochures,

- A great base salary of €14.99 gross per hour 💵

To keep the warehouse running smoothly, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a

day. It is a dynamic environment where there is always something to do. 🏃‍♀️‍➡️ Many of your colleagues are
